bio.text: Gay Valimont is the Democratic nominee for Florida's 1st Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She was born in Thomaston, Georgia, earned a bachelor's degree from Georgia Southern University in 1996 and a graduate degree from Troy State University in 2000.
According to her Ballotpedia survey, she worked in sports medicine in Atlanta, including with the Atlanta Falcons.
